composition.adapters: before the runtime: composeEmrAdapters({ ...runtimeAdapters, stored: clinicalStoredReader(runtimeAdapters.stored) }) (api/src/emr-clinical/sources.ts) so that A resolves the source versions a finding incorporates; composeClinicalRuntime refuses (ClinicalSourcesNotComposed) otherwise
composition.call: composeClinicalRuntime({ db, ledger, context, studies, signatures }) once at server start, then runtime.start() (restart scan of open originals and unconfirmed SR adoptions)
composition.context: B2 ClinicalContextSource.facts(request): verified ActorFacts (immutable identity, roles, institution, signing registration), trusted ingress address, request ID, member(subject) resolver, and C's carried device signature {jws, osUserId}
composition.studies: C ClinicalStudySource.facts(db, studyId): managing institution and patient link snapshot
composition.signatures: C SignatureVerificationPorts: KeyReader of registered device keys, KeyPolicy (production: tpm-nonexportable only), AnchorReader, reviewed TimePolicy
composition.services: the six owning services reach unit D through api/src/emr-clinical/services.ts (the port, projection registration, readClinicalRows/readClinicalUnits/readClinicalSources, wording); Nest constructs them before the server start has B1's ledger, B2's context and C's ports, so the start binds the composed runtime once (bindClinicalPort; a second binding is refused, nothing per request replaces it)
composition.raw_sql_check: tests/admin_audit_attribution_test.cjs (shared, CI writer) must read the real composition: see the EMR-D round 3 result integration_remaining DR2-08 for the observed unresolved candidates and the exact rule change
composition.absent: every owning service answers 503 EMR_CLINICAL_RUNTIME_REQUIRED before any database work; no legacy write or body path remains
